headline: Nissan UK is starting its first real-world driverless pilot, in Cambridge.

summary: WardsAuto reports, citing Nissan's release of 28 Sep 2026, that Nissan UK will run a self-driving pilot called ADventure in Cambridge, using an adapted 2022 Nissan Leaf to test how automated driving can improve access for people who do not drive. The pilot grows out of a government-funded research project that began at the University of Warwick in September 2023, and this is older news carried again.
